40015447.author: पदार्थः
40015447.content: नरवानरराजानौ king of men and monkeys, वायुसुतः son of wind god, सःकपिः that Vanara, ऋक्षराजः king of Bears, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, राक्षसः Rakshasa, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, वालिपुत्रः son of Vali, अङ्गदः Angada, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, शरभः Sarabha कपिः monkey, सहदायादः accompanied by kin, सुषेणः Sushena, मैन्दः Mainda, द्विविदएवच and Dwivida also, गजः Gaja, अथ so also, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, कुमुदः Kumuda, तथा likewise, नलः Nala, अथ and पनसः Panasa, अमित्रविषयम् at the enemy city, प्राप्ताः having reached, समवेताः collected, समर्थयन् thought.

40015447.author: Translation
40015447.content: Sugriva the king of men and monkeys, Hanuman the son of wind god, Jambavan the king of Bears, Vibheeshana, Vali's son Angada, Sarabha, accompanied by his kin Sushena, Mainda, Dwivida, Gaja, Gavaksha, Kumuda, the wise Nala and Panasa arrived at the enemy city and collected together thought like this.

40015448.author: पदार्थः
40015448.content: नरवानरराजानौ king of men and monkeys, वायुसुतः son of wind god, सःकपिः that Vanara, ऋक्षराजः king of Bears, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, राक्षसः Rakshasa, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, वालिपुत्रः son of Vali, अङ्गदः Angada, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, शरभः Sarabha कपिः monkey, सहदायादः accompanied by kin, सुषेणः Sushena, मैन्दः Mainda, द्विविदएवच and Dwivida also, गजः Gaja, अथ so also, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, कुमुदः Kumuda, तथा likewise, नलः Nala, अथ and पनसः Panasa, अमित्रविषयम् at the enemy city, प्राप्ताः having reached, समवेताः collected, समर्थयन् thought.

40015448.author: Translation
40015448.content: Sugriva the king of men and monkeys, Hanuman the son of wind god, Jambavan the king of Bears, Vibheeshana, Vali's son Angada, Sarabha, accompanied by his kin Sushena, Mainda, Dwivida, Gaja, Gavaksha, Kumuda, the wise Nala and Panasa arrived at the enemy city and collected together thought like this.

40015448.author: सारांशः
40015448.content: Vibheeshana reveals to Rama the arrangements made by Ravana to protect Lanka. Sri Rama and Sugriva discuss the plans for success.

40015449.author: पदार्थः
40015449.content: नरवानरराजानौ king of men and monkeys, वायुसुतः son of wind god, सःकपिः that Vanara, ऋक्षराजः king of Bears, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, राक्षसः Rakshasa, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, वालिपुत्रः son of Vali, अङ्गदः Angada, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, शरभः Sarabha कपिः monkey, सहदायादः accompanied by kin, सुषेणः Sushena, मैन्दः Mainda, द्विविदएवच and Dwivida also, गजः Gaja, अथ so also, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, कुमुदः Kumuda, तथा likewise, नलः Nala, अथ and पनसः Panasa, अमित्रविषयम् at the enemy city, प्राप्ताः having reached, समवेताः collected, समर्थयन् thought.

40015449.author: Translation
40015449.content: Sugriva the king of men and monkeys, Hanuman the son of wind god, Jambavan the king of Bears, Vibheeshana, Vali's son Angada, Sarabha, accompanied by his kin Sushena, Mainda, Dwivida, Gaja, Gavaksha, Kumuda, the wise Nala and Panasa arrived at the enemy city and collected together thought like this.

40015449.author: सारांशः
40015449.content: Vibheeshana reveals to Rama the arrangements made by Ravana to protect Lanka. Sri Rama and Sugriva discuss the plans for success.

40015450.author: पदार्थः
40015450.content: रावणपालिता ruled by Ravana, सासुरोरगगन्धर्वैः Devas, demons and Gandharvas, अमरैरपि immortals, दुर्जया not conquerable, सा that, इयम् this, लङ्कापुरी Lanka city, लक्षयते appears.

40015450.author: Translation
40015450.content: "This Lanka city ruled by Ravana is seen. It appears that this city is unconquerable to Devas, demons and Gandharvas also by the immortals."

40015451.author: पदार्थः
40015451.content: कार्यसिद्धिम् to achieve success, पुरस्कृत्य preparing, विनिर्णये determining duty, मन्त्रयध्वम् , अत्र there, राक्षसाधिपः Rakshasa king, रावणः Ravana, नित्यम् ever, सन्निहितःहि present here.

40015451.author: Translation
40015451.content: "Rakshasa king Ravana is ever present here. Prepare yourself to achieve success in the mission and determine your duty."

40015452.author: पदार्थः
40015452.content: तथा like that, तेषु they, ब्रुवाणेषु speaking to one another, रावणावरजः Ravana's brother, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, अग्राम्यपदवत् courteous words, पुष्कलार्थम् meaningful, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40015452.author: Translation
40015452.content: While they were speaking like that to one another, Ravana's brother Vibheeshana spoke courteously, words full of meaning.

40015453.author: पदार्थः
40015453.content: मम my, अमात्याः ministers, अनलः Anala, शरभश्चैव and Sarabha, सम्पातिः Sampathi, तथा so also, प्रघसः Praghasa, लङ्कांपुरीम् to Lanka city, गत्वा went, पुनः again, इह there, आगताः came

40015453.author: Translation
40015453.content: "My ministers Anala, Sarabha, Sampathi and also Praghasa went to Lanka and saw it and returned."

40015454.author: पदार्थः
40015454.content: सर्वे all, शकुनयः birds, भूत्वा form, रिपोः enemy, बलम् strength, प्रविष्टाः went in deep, यत् , विधानम् arrangements, विहितम् knowing, तत् there, दृष्टवा seeing, समुपस्थिताः turned up.

40015454.author: Translation
40015454.content: All of them assumed the form of birds and went deep into Lanka, saw the enemy strength and arrangements made by the enemy and turned up.

40015455.author: पदार्थः
40015455.content: राम Rama, ते to you, दुरात्मनः evil minded, रावणस्य Ravana 's, संविधानम् army is organized, यथा that way, आहुः alas, सर्वम् everything, याथात्त्वेन as it is, ब्रुवतः told, मे to me, शृणु listen.

40015455.author: Translation
40015455.content: "Rama! Alas, they told me everything of the way evil minded Ravana's army is organized as it is. Listen to me."

40015456.author: पदार्थः
40015456.content: प्रबलः powerful, प्रहस्तः Prahasta, पूर्वंद्वारम् at east gate, आसाद्य with army, तिष्ठति remains, महावीर्यौ of great valour, महापार्श्वमहोदरौ Mahaparsva and Mahodara, दक्षइणंच at south gate

40015456.author: Translation
40015456.content: "Powerful Prahasta stands at east gate with army, Mahaparsva and Mahodara of great valour are at the south gate."

40015457.author: पदार्थः
40015457.content: रावणात्मजः Ravana's own son, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, पट्टसासिधनुष्मद्भिः sharp iron words, bows and spears, शोलमुद्गरपाणिभिः arrows and darts, बहुभिः numerous, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, वृतः surrounded by, नानाप्रहरणैः many kinds of weapons, शूरैः heroes, आवृतः collected together, पश्चिमंद्वारम् west gate.

40015457.author: Translation
40015457.content: "Ravana's own son, Indrajith stands at the west gate surrounded by numerous Rakshasas collected together wielding sharp swords, bows, spears, arrows and darts and many kinds of weapons."

40015458.author: पदार्थः
40015458.content: रावणः Ravana, शस्त्रपाणिभिः wielding weapons, राक्षसानाम् with Rakshasas, बहुभिः many, वृतः surrounded by, सहस्रैः thousands, युक्तः skilled, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, परमसंविग्नः highly agitated, उत्तरम् north, नगरद्वारम् gate of the city, स्वयम् himself, आस्थितः stands.

40015458.author: Translation
40015458.content: "Ravana himself stands at the north gate of Lanka, highly agitated surrounded by many thousands of Rakshasas wielding weapons."

40015459.author: पदार्थः
40015459.content: रावणः Ravana, शस्त्रपाणिभिः wielding weapons, राक्षसानाम् with Rakshasas, बहुभिः many, वृतः surrounded by, सहस्रैः thousands, युक्तः skilled, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, परमसंविग्नः highly agitated, उत्तरम् north, नगरद्वारम् gate of the city, स्वयम् himself, आस्थितः stands.

40015459.author: Translation
40015459.content: "Ravana himself stands at the north gate of Lanka, highly agitated surrounded by many thousands of Rakshasas wielding weapons."

40015460.author: पदार्थः
40015460.content: विरूपाक्षस्तु Virupaksha, शूलखडगधनुष्मता with spears, swords and bows, महता mighty, बलेन army, राक्षसैः of Rakshasas, सार्थम् accompanied by, मध्यमंगुल्मम् middle of city, आस्थितः remains.

40015460.author: Translation
40015460.content: "Virupaksha stands in the middle of Lanka wielding spears, swords, bows and arrows accompanied by mighty army."

40015461.author: पदार्थः
40015461.content: मामकाः our, सर्वे all, तेमन्त्रिणः the ministers, एवंविधान् in this way, एतान् them, गुल्मान् in the city, लङ्कायाम् of Lanka, समुदीक्ष्य keenly observed, शीघ्रम् immediately, पुनः again, इह here, आगताः reached.

40015461.author: Translation
40015461.content: All our ministers immediately returned back after keenly observing the city of Lanka in this way.

40015462.author: पदार्थः
40015462.content: गजानाम् elephant riders, दशसाहस्रम् ten thousands, तथा similarly, रथानाम् charioteers, अयुतम् ten thousands, हयानाम् horse riders, द्वे, आयुते twenty thousand, रक्षसाम् foot soldiers, साग्रा more than, कोटिश्च one crore, संयुगेषु in wars, विक्रान्ताः valiant warriors, बलवन्तश्च mighty strong, आततायिनः endeavouring to kill, एते all, निशाचराः night rangers, नित्यम् always, राक्षसराजस्य Rakshasa king's, इष्टाः dear.

40015462.author: Translation
40015462.content: "Elephant army of ten thousand, similarly ten thousand charioteers, horse riders in twenty thousand, more than a crore foot soldiers, mighty strong and valiant warriors, night ranger's beloved to Ravana, the king of Rakshasas were staying close and serving."

40015463.author: पदार्थः
40015463.content: गजानाम् elephant riders, दशसाहस्रम् ten thousands, तथा similarly, रथानाम् charioteers, अयुतम् ten thousands, हयानाम् horse riders, द्वे, आयुते twenty thousand, रक्षसाम् foot soldiers, साग्रा more than, कोटिश्च one crore, संयुगेषु in wars, विक्रान्ताः valiant warriors, बलवन्तश्च mighty strong, आततायिनः endeavouring to kill, एते all, निशाचराः night rangers, नित्यम् always, राक्षसराजस्य Rakshasa king's, इष्टाः dear.

40015463.author: Translation
40015463.content: "Elephant army of ten thousand, similarly ten thousand charioteers, horse riders in twenty thousand, more than a crore foot soldiers, mighty strong and valiant warriors, night ranger's beloved to Ravana, the king of Rakshasas were staying close and serving."

40015464.author: पदार्थः
40015464.content: विशाम्पते Lord of men, अत्र there, एकस्य for one, राक्षसस्य Rakshasa, युद्धार्थे to assist in war, सहस्राणाम् thousands of, सहस्रम् thousands, परीवारः at the service, उपतिष्ठते are staying.

40015464.author: Translation
40015464.content: "O! Lord of men! For the sake of assisting one Rakshasa in war ten lakhs of Rakshasas are staying at his service."

40015465.author: पदार्थः
40015465.content: महाबाहुः mighty armed, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, मन्त्रिप्रोक्तम् told by ministers, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, एताम् all this, प्रवृत्तिम् information, एनम् thus, उक्त्वा having said, तान् he, राक्षसान् by Rakshasas, अदर्शयत् revealed.

40015465.author: Translation
40015465.content: Mighty armed Vibheeshana revealed to Rama all the information that was told to him by ministers.

40015466.author: पदार्थः
40015466.content: श्रीमान् prosperous, रावणावरजः Ravana's brother, लङ्कायाम् about Lanka, सर्वम् everything, सचिवैः ministers, रामाय to Rama, प्रत्यवेदयत् having submitted, कमलपत्राक्षम् lotus eyed, रामम् Rama, रामप्रियचिकीर्षया intending to please Rama, इदम् this, उत्तरम् reply, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40015466.author: Translation
40015466.content: Again, Vibheeshana, the prosperous brother of Ravana, spoke to Rama everything about Lanka made known to him by the ministers. Vibheeshana looking at the lotus petal eyed Rama, intending to please Rama, spoke.

40015467.author: पदार्थः
40015467.content: राम Rama, रावणः Ravana, यदा like that, कुबेरम् at Kubera, प्रत्ययुध्यत offensive, तदा then, रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, षष्टिः sixty, शतसहस्राणि lakh, निर्यान्ति sallied forth, पराक्रमेण in courage, वीर्येण in valour, तेजसा brilliance, सत्त्वगौरवात् with respect, दर्पेण proud, यत्र there, दुरात्मनः evil minded, रावणस्य Ravana 's, सदृशाः befitting.

40015467.author: Translation
40015467.content: "Rama! Earlier when Ravana launched an offensive battle against Kubera, sixty thousand Rakshasas who were equal to him in valour, brilliance, courage, and with respect sallied forth the proud, the evil minded Ravana."

40015468.author: पदार्थः
40015468.content: राम Rama, रावणः Ravana, यदा like that, कुबेरम् at Kubera, प्रत्ययुध्यत offensive, तदा then, रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, षष्टिः sixty, शतसहस्राणि lakh, निर्यान्ति sallied forth, पराक्रमेण in courage, वीर्येण in valour, तेजसा brilliance, सत्त्वगौरवात् with respect, दर्पेण proud, यत्र there, दुरात्मनः evil minded, रावणस्य Ravana 's, सदृशाः befitting.

40015468.author: Translation
40015468.content: "Rama! Earlier when Ravana launched an offensive battle against Kubera, sixty thousand Rakshasas who were equal to him in valour, brilliance, courage, and with respect sallied forth the proud, the evil minded Ravana."

40015469.author: पदार्थः
40015469.content: अत्र here in this case, मन्युः indignation, नकर्तव्यः as my duty, त्वाम् to you, रोषये not to cause anger, नभीषये not to cause fear, वीर्येण in valour, सुराणाम् Devatas, निग्रहेऽपिमोल can resist, समर्थः capable, असिहि am telling.

40015469.author: Translation
40015469.content: "Here, in this case do not be angry. I am telling out of my duty and not out of indignation or to cause anger or fear in you. You are capable of resisting even Devatas."

40015470.author: पदार्थः
40015470.content: तत् and also, भवान् you, इदम् these, वानरानीकम् army of Vanaras, व्यूह्य with, चतुरङ्गेणबलेन four kinds of army force, वृतः surrounded, रावणम् Ravana, निर्मथिष्यति crush.

40015470.author: Translation
40015470.content: "You also have these Vanara armies surrounded by four kinds of army, elephants, chariots, cavalry and foot soldiers."

40015471.author: पदार्थः
40015471.content: रावणावरजे Ravana's younger brother, इति this way, वाक्यम् words, ब्रुवति spoke इति this, राघवः Raghava, शत्रूणाम् enemies, प्रतिघातार्थम् issued orders to attack, इदम् thus, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् had spoken

40015471.author: Translation
40015471.content: When Ravana's younger brother spoke in that way Raghava instructed the army to attack the enemy.

40015472.author: पदार्थः
40015472.content: लङ्कायाः at Lanka's, पूर्वद्वारे east gate, वानरपुङ्गवः Vanara leader, नीलः Neela, बहुभिः many more, वानरैः Vanaras, वृतः surrounded, प्रहस्तप्रतियोद्धा to Prahasta give fight, स्यात् with.

40015472.author: Translation
40015472.content: "Let the Vanara leader Neela along with Vanaras stay at the east gate of Lanka and give fight to Prahasta."

40015473.author: पदार्थः
40015473.content: वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, अङ्गदः Angada, महता mighty, बलेन powerful, वृतः along with, दक्षिणेद्वारे south gate, महापार्श्वमहोदरौ Mahaparsva and Mahodara, बाधताम् crush.

40015473.author: Translation
40015473.content: "Let Vali's son the mighty and powerful Angada along with army crush Mahaparsva and Mahodara at the south gate."

40015474.author: पदार्थः
40015474.content: पवनात्मजः wind god's son, अप्रमेयात्मा of unimaginable prowess, हनुमान् Hanuman, बहुभिः numerous, कपिभिः Vanaras, वृतः surrounded by, पश्चिमद्वारम् west gate, निपीड्य pressing, प्रविशतु enter.

40015474.author: Translation
40015474.content: "Let Hanuman, the wind god's son of unimaginable prowess, enter the west gate along with numerous Vanaras and press against the enemy."

40015475.author: पदार्थः
40015475.content: दैत्यदानवसङ्घानाम् multitude of Daityas and Danavas, महात्मनाम् great self, ऋषीणांच even sages, विप्रकारप्रियः fond of doing harm, क्षुद्रः wicked, वरदानबलान्वितः armed by the boons received, यः he, प्रजाः people, सन्तापयन् oppressing, सर्वान् all, लोकान् people, परिक्रामिति wandering, तस्य, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa leader, वधे destroy, अहम् I, स्वयमेव myself, धृतः determined, अहम् I, सौमित्रिणासह along with Lakshmana, सबलः along with army, रावणः Ravana, यत्र, उत्तरंनगरद्वारम् north gate, निपीड्य persecuting, अभिप्रवेक्ष्यामि force my entry into.

40015475.author: Translation
40015475.content: "That Ravana who is harming Daityas and Danavas, and great souls following wicked practices and armed by the boons is oppressing all people wandering all over. I, with Lakshmana, have determined to persecute and kill him and force my entry to the north gate."

40015476.author: पदार्थः
40015476.content: दैत्यदानवसङ्घानाम् multitude of Daityas and Danavas, महात्मनाम् great self, ऋषीणांच even sages, विप्रकारप्रियः fond of doing harm, क्षुद्रः wicked, वरदानबलान्वितः armed by the boons received, यः he, प्रजाः people, सन्तापयन् oppressing, सर्वान् all, लोकान् people, परिक्रामिति wandering, तस्य, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa leader, वधे destroy, अहम् I, स्वयमेव myself, धृतः determined, अहम् I, सौमित्रिणासह along with Lakshmana, सबलः along with army, रावणः Ravana, यत्र, उत्तरंनगरद्वारम् north gate, निपीड्य persecuting, अभिप्रवेक्ष्यामि force my entry into.

40015476.author: Translation
40015476.content: "That Ravana who is harming Daityas and Danavas, and great souls following wicked practices and armed by the boons is oppressing all people wandering all over. I, with Lakshmana, have determined to persecute and kill him and force my entry to the north gate."

40015477.author: पदार्थः
40015477.content: दैत्यदानवसङ्घानाम् multitude of Daityas and Danavas, महात्मनाम् great self, ऋषीणांच even sages, विप्रकारप्रियः fond of doing harm, क्षुद्रः wicked, वरदानबलान्वितः armed by the boons received, यः he, प्रजाः people, सन्तापयन् oppressing, सर्वान् all, लोकान् people, परिक्रामिति wandering, तस्य, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa leader, वधे destroy, अहम् I, स्वयमेव myself, धृतः determined, अहम् I, सौमित्रिणासह along with Lakshmana, सबलः along with army, रावणः Ravana, यत्र, उत्तरंनगरद्वारम् north gate, निपीड्य persecuting, अभिप्रवेक्ष्यामि force my entry into.

40015477.author: Translation
40015477.content: "That Ravana who is harming Daityas and Danavas, and great souls following wicked practices and armed by the boons is oppressing all people wandering all over. I, with Lakshmana, have determined to persecute and kill him and force my entry to the north gate."

40015478.author: पदार्थः
40015478.content: बलवान् mighty strong, वानरेन्द्रश्च Vanara king, वीर्यवान् valorous, ऋक्षराजश्च Rksharaja, Jambavan, राक्षसेन्द्रानुजश्चैव and Ravana's brother, मध्यम: middle, गुलो of city, भवतु will remain.

40015478.author: Translation
40015478.content: "Mighty strong Sugriva, valorous Jambavan, the ruler of Vanaras and Vibheeshana, brother of Ravana will remain at the middle of Lanka and fight."

40015479.author: पदार्थः
40015479.content: आहवे in battle, हरिभिः monkeys, मानुषं human, रूपम् form, नचैवम् not have, कार्यम् task, अस्मिन् our, युद्धे war, वानरे Vanaras, बले, एषा in that way, संज्ञा sign, भवतु let it be.

40015479.author: Translation
40015479.content: "In the battle like this at present Vanaras should not be in the semblance of humans. Let this be our sign."

40015480.author: पदार्थः
40015480.content: अस्मिन् our, स्वजने own people, वानराःएव even Vanaras, नः not, चिह्नम् recognize, भविष्यति should be able to, महौजसौ very chivalrous, भ्रात्रा brother, लक्ष्मणेन Lakshmana, एषः similarly, अहम् I, आत्मना my own, पञ्चमः five of us, ममसखा our friends, अयम् our, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, वयम् also, सप्तमानुषेणैव seven human forms, परान् enemies, योत्स्यामहे wage war.

40015480.author: Translation
40015480.content: "To know our own people the Vanaras are the sign of recognition Chivalrous Lakshmana, my brother, similarly five of us and our friend Vibheeshana, these seven people alone will wage war in human form."

40015481.author: पदार्थः
40015481.content: अस्मिन् our, स्वजने own people, वानराःएव even Vanaras, नः not, चिह्नम् recognize, भविष्यति should be able to, महौजसौ very chivalrous, भ्रात्रा brother, लक्ष्मणेन Lakshmana, एषः similarly, अहम् I, आत्मना my own, पञ्चमः five of us, ममसखा our friends, अयम् our, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, वयम् also, सप्तमानुषेणैव seven human forms, परान् enemies, योत्स्यामहे wage war.

40015481.author: Translation
40015481.content: "To know our own people the Vanaras are the sign of recognition Chivalrous Lakshmana, my brother, similarly five of us and our friend Vibheeshana, these seven people alone will wage war in human form."

40015482.author: पदार्थः
40015482.content: मतिमान् wise, मतिम् in mind, सःरामः that Rama, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, सुवेलस्यगिरिः Suvela mountain, रमणीयतरम् beauty, तटम् slopes, दृष्टवा seeing, कृत्यसिध्यर्थम् for accomplishing the task, सुवेलारोहणे climb up, बुद्धिम् thought, चकार and went.

40015482.author: Translation
40015482.content: Wise Rama having spoken like that to Vibheeshana for accomplishing the task, looking at the beauty of Suvela mountain slopes, climbed up and went.

40015483.author: पदार्थः
40015483.content: मतिमान् wise, मतिम् in mind, सःरामः that Rama, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, सुवेलस्यगिरिः Suvela mountain, रमणीयतरम् beauty, तटम् slopes, दृष्टवा seeing, कृत्यसिध्यर्थम् for accomplishing the task, सुवेलारोहणे climb up, बुद्धिम् thought, चकार and went.

40015483.author: Translation
40015483.content: Wise Rama having spoken like that to Vibheeshana for accomplishing the task, looking at the beauty of Suvela mountain slopes, climbed up and went.
